Manufacturing

Manufacturing & Testing Capability

A structured view of production, verification and quality-control stages.

Manufacturing

Four catalog-listed plant areas support large transformers, distribution transformers, intelligent switchgear and welding; the catalog also lists 460 units/sets of large mechanical equipment and 60 types of supporting test equipment.

Testing

The catalog describes a six-sided shielded transformer laboratory with a 2,400 kV lightning impulse system, 300 kV power-frequency withstand system, 8-channel partial-discharge detector, WT3000 power analyzer and independent generator set.

Quality Control

QMS is described as providing full-process quality traceability, alongside MES production planning, WMS warehouse management and SRM supply-chain collaboration.

Production Capacity

Published catalog figures: 1,200 large main transformers, 12,000 distribution transformers, 10,000 box-type substations and 15,000 complete switchgear units/sets per year.
